text:
Nora Chen: Quick check — I'm about to switch svc-cassandra from Deployment -> StatefulSet in the terraform branch `feature/sts-cassandra`. Main goals: stable pod DNS names, ordered shutdown/start, and PVC-per-node. Before I push the plan, a couple of Qs/notes: 
- I plan `replicas: 3` -> keep 3 for now, maybe scale to 5 later.
- podManagementPolicy: OrderedReady (needed for cassandra).
- updateStrategy: RollingUpdate with a partition so we can control canary.
- lifecycle.preStop: call nodetool drain (we'll add).
- PVCs: will import existing PVCs in TF to avoid recreation. Any other gotchas? :thinking:

Lee Park: LGTM overall. A few gotchas: 
- HPA: HPA doesn't autoscale StatefulSet out of the box in our cluster unless we enable `scale` subresource for the k8s API / controller; better to rely on manual scaling or a controller that knows cassandra topology.
- PVC resizing: expanding is fine if the storage class supports `allowVolumeExpansion`, but shrinking isn't possible. If you need larger volumes, plan an offline resize or create new PVCs + nodetool decommission.

Aj Malhotra: Also add readinessProbe that checks `nodetool status` / local port 9042 responding, otherwise the rolling update can mark pods ready too early. For update strategy I recommend:

```yaml
updateStrategy:
  type: RollingUpdate
  rollingUpdate:
    partition: 1  # start canary by leaving index >=1 untouched until we verify index 0
podManagementPolicy: OrderedReady
```

That partition value lets us roll one pod at a time manually.

Sahil Gupta: One more infra-to-code note: in terraform use `kubernetes_stateful_set_v1` and import existing `kubernetes_persistent_volume_claim` resources. Example TF snippet: 

```hcl
resource "kubernetes_stateful_set_v1" "cassandra" {
  metadata { name = "svc-cassandra" }
  spec {
    service_name = "cassandra"
    replicas = 3
    selector { match_labels = { app = "cassandra" } }
    template { ... }
    volume_claim_template { ... }
    update_strategy {
      type = "RollingUpdate"
      rolling_update { partition = 1 }
    }
    pod_management_policy = "OrderedReady"
  }
}
```

Make sure to `terraform import` the existing PVCs and the statefulset name so TF doesn't try to delete/create PVCs.

Marie O'Neill: For canary: I'd prefer to do a canary window of 30m, run a small load test (read/write) against the canary node and verify metrics (latency, tombstones) in Console. If anything looks off, we can rollback by setting `partition` back to current pod index. :+1:

Nora Chen: Awesome — I'll update the branch with:
- OrderedReady + RollingUpdate(partition=1)
- preStop hook for `nodetool drain`
- readinessProbe on 9042
- import commands in PR description so infra can run them before apply

infra-bot: terraform plan OK in feature/sts-cassandra (ran on staging). No resource replacements detected if PVCs are imported first.

Nora Chen: I'll add the import commands to the PR and ping infra for a short maintenance window. Targeting staging canary tomorrow morning.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for svc-cassandra -> 1/3 pods drained and replaced (canary). :rocket:

Lee Park: If canary looks good, remember to bump partition to 0 to continue rolling update or set replicas appropriately. Also keep an eye on CPU/IO for the new pods.

Sahil Gupta: I'll be on-call during the canary, ping me in #oncall if anything spikes.

Nora Chen: Thanks all — PR in 10m, will tag you for review.
